verdicts.reason: Both just shrink the square's two-column layout into the portrait canvas without rearranging it. The book cover stays a small block in the right column and a large dead area sits under it on the right, so neither suits the tall format. Text and the bullet list also shrink, and the cover is not given more presence. A spreads the stack over the height with roughly the original's rhythm. B starts lower, leaving an empty band above the logo, then squeezes the bullets and CTA together and leaves about 160px of empty space at the bottom, so its balance is slightly worse.
